reviewer: Independent publisher visual inspection and requester preview approval
brief: Original neutral American heroic-comic construction example: elderly harbor keeper opens hinged gate at dawn.
referenceObservations: Requester approved these neutral keeper panels as the stronger public example. Retained first panel is the accepted target for identity, coat value planes and projected harbor setting.
limitations: Simplified vector/cel illustration, two keyed poses and one camera; not naturalistic brush-ink mastery or articulated animation. Fingers and subtle acting remain stylized.

observations.proportionsIdentity: Consistent elderly human keeper, long coat and cap; adult head/body proportion, not a mascot substitution.
observations.connectedFormsContacts: Extended sleeve follows changed elbow/wrist chain; fingers move to projected latch while gate pivots about fixed right post.
observations.gestureExpression: Smile and extended forearm communicate completed opening; identity and cap remain consistent.
observations.inkFormShadows: Dark coat-side planes and narrower fold/hatch strokes distinguish volumes; face has limited cheek/jaw shadow, still cel-like.
observations.perspectiveDepth: Projected paving, curbs, bollards and gate share one camera; foreground keeper overlaps gate, with lighthouse and sea behind.
observations.speciesDesign: Ordinary elderly human harbor keeper; beard, cap and raincoat are readable, no fantasy species or private character.
observations.storyTone: Calm dawn harbor routine: closed gate then opened passage and reassurance. Passing rain is visible with sunrise.
